description: Prepare a request about one yacht for the person to review and send themselves on yachtfinder.co. This tool never sends anything: it saves a draft (the yacht, optional dates and up to 5 short questions) and returns one link. Give the person the link and tell them plainly that nothing has been sent: on that page they read and edit the draft, sign in, add their own details, and only their tap on Send sends it, under the usual inquiry limits. Take `yacht` from the `id` of a find_yachts, yachts_near or yacht_facts answer; a name is not searched. Questions are shown as plain text: links, markup and line breaks are removed. Do not put names, email addresses or phone numbers in them. The draft expires after 24 hours.

date_from.description: First day of interest, YYYY-MM-DD: today or later, at most 12 months ahead.

date_to.description: Last day of interest, YYYY-MM-DD, with date_from.

questions.description: Up to 5 questions for the listing broker, each at most 300 characters, in the person's words.

yacht.description: The yacht's id from another answer (its `id` field). Not a name and not a link.

name: prepare_inquiry

data_as_of.description: When YachtFinder last rebuilt the catalog this answer was read from (ISO 8601).

sent.description: Always false: this tool never sends.

url.description: The page where the person reviews, edits and sends the draft.
